verdict.rationale: Asaas is a SaaS payments platform, so a privacy control letting users opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. The docs cover only payments, the sandbox, authentication, and the docs MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
